features.feature: User-visible outcome: lifecycle readiness completes faster and more predictably while reporting the same reviewer evidence verdicts.
Create one immutable prompt-envelope snapshot per collectReviewerEvidenceState call and thread it through evidence binding, prompt-envelope verification, and incremental eligibility lookup.
Bound prompt-envelope reads to one collection-scoped snapshot for multi-record collections, with no per-record rereads and a constant bound independent of record count.
Independent direct callers that omit the optional snapshot retain existing direct-read behavior and the same fail-closed results.
Signature, envelope-integrity, scope, freshness, dispatch-binding, review-run, and task-semantic checks remain fail-closed.
Missing, empty, malformed, or unreadable envelope sources preserve refusal and diagnostics and never make a reviewer record eligible or gate-passing.
Mixed valid, stale, duplicate, and ineligible records preserve ordering, deduplication, cutoff inclusivity, stale classification, eligibility, and aggregate gate outcomes.
The shared snapshot remains immutable or isolated against mutation, truncation, reordering, or filtering, with no cross-record or cross-collection contamination.
Separate runs and sequential collections receive separate snapshots, so a source change cannot be hidden by stale cached state.

Cached and uncached executions remain field-equivalent for accepted and rejected records, integrity verdicts, incremental eligibility and cutoff, reviewer evidence state, finding/pass classification, and lifecycle-gate outcome.
B-dc83 business implementation files remain outside this story; this is a separate prompt-envelope cache maintenance story.
features.excluded_by: Frozen scope-boundary and execution-boundary explicitly exclude B-dc83 business implementation files.

features.feature: Direct edits to docs/story and tests/fixtures remain outside this story.
features.excluded_by: Frozen scope-boundary and execution-boundary exclude docs/story and tests/fixtures.

features.feature: Runtime-enforcement bypasses and any weakening of lifecycle evidence gates are outside this story.
features.excluded_by: The frozen scope excludes runtime-enforcement bypasses; the decision rejects bypassing runtime enforcement and requires all integrity checks to remain active.

features.feature: Claude reviewers and non-Codex review evidence are outside this review scope.
features.excluded_by: Frozen scope excludes Claude reviewers and the story requires Codex-only review evidence.

features.feature: No global or cross-command cache, Authority/remote claim, or lifecycle-phase bypass is part of this story.
features.excluded_by: The chosen decision is per-collection snapshot threading; global caching and runtime enforcement bypasses are explicitly rejected.
